target_customer: Investors (funds, private equity) and companies doing commercial due diligence
problem: Commercial diligence needs many expert and customer interviews and documents analyzed over weeks; LATO agents run interviews and build a live market simulation in hours.
business_model: B2B subscription or per study for investors; pricing not published
product_category: AI market research and simulation for investors

founders.name: Tymek Staniszewski
prior_employers: Verdane (six years in growth and private equity)

founders.name: Tien Chu
prior_employers: Enterprise R&D, research labs and early stage startups (unnamed on YC page)
education: University of Warsaw, CS, Math and Philosophy

investors: Angels incl. Paul Graham and co-founders of Vercel, ElevenLabs, Snowflake and Rogo

competitors.name: AlphaSense (with Tegus)
competitors.what: Expert call transcripts library and AI led expert interviews

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice interview agents, document analysis and synthesis into simulations are demanding but built on available models.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated interviews could compound but incumbents hold large libraries.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AlphaSense already offered an AI interviewer in 2026.

market_need_then: Funds pay heavily for expert calls and diligence; YC page claims funds managing over $400bn use LATO (company claim).

identity.visual_style: Clean and minimal with product screenshots
identity.voice_and_tone: Bold, confident claims such as Recreate any market

brand_strength.rationale: Little third party coverage; shares its name with a common font and other firms.

outcome_analysis: LATO is a two person Summer 2026 San Francisco company with a founder from growth private equity, backed by YC, Air Street and Axiom plus notable angels. Outcome is unknown. The finance background gives distribution into funds, while AlphaSense and expert networks already sell similar diligence.
notes: Round amount and date undisclosed; stage is other as the YC page does not state one. A Dealroom LATO entry in London with $500-750k enterprise value may be a different company, unverified. The word lato means summer in Polish for the font; no source gives the company's name origin. Confidence medium because funding amount is missing.
